steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: show-furniture-footprints
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')]; const view = btns.find(b => /^\s*View/.test(b.textContent||'')); if (view) view.click(); })()

steps.name: select-curtain
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const c = st.items.find(i => i.defId === 'curtains'); window.__curtainId = c ? c.id : null; if (c) st.selectItem(c.id); })()

steps.name: assert-curtain-gated
steps.eval: (() => { const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props .label')].map(e => (e.textContent||'').trim()); const hasX = labels.includes('X (m)'); const hasAngle = labels.includes('Angle (°)'); const hasWidth = labels.includes('Width (m)'); const hint = /Fixed to its window/i.test(document.body.textContent||''); const knob = !!document.querySelector('[data-rot-handle]'); window.__curtainCheck = { hasX, hasAngle, hasWidth, hint, knob }; if (hasX) throw new Error('curtain still shows X field'); if (hasAngle) throw new Error('curtain still shows Angle field'); if (!hasWidth) throw new Error('curtain lost its Width (size) field'); if (!hint) throw new Error('curtain hint missing'); if (knob) throw new Error('curtain still shows rotate knob'); })()

steps.name: select-normal
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const n = st.items.find(i => i.defId !== 'curtains' && !i.locked && !(st.__catalog && false)); window.__normalId = n ? n.id : null; if (n) st.selectItem(n.id); })()

steps.name: assert-normal-present
steps.eval: (() => { const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-props .label')].map(e => (e.textContent||'').trim()); const hasX = labels.includes('X (m)'); const hasAngle = labels.includes('Angle (°)'); const knob = !!document.querySelector('[data-rot-handle]'); const hint = /Fixed to its window/i.test(document.body.textContent||''); window.__normalCheck = { hasX, hasAngle, knob, hint }; if (!hasX) throw new Error('normal item missing X field'); if (!hasAngle) throw new Error('normal item missing Angle field'); if (!knob) throw new Error('normal item missing rotate knob'); if (hint) throw new Error('normal item wrongly shows window hint'); })()
